title: Link unlinked ChatBackend freeze blockers to lrgt
description: Freeze blocker from the fourth 2026-10-21 freeze review. Three open beads change the chat-server public API or the documented ChatBackend contract, have no 'bd:' commit trailer at HEAD c59916d8, and do not block JMAP-lrgt: (1) JMAP-559u: ChatBackend::may_broadcast_mention (backend.rs:1869) takes space_id but no chat_id, so channel permissionOverrides cannot be applied (chat-00 L1619 MUST); the fix is a breaking trait signature change. (2) JMAP-kgx2: chat-server/src/permissions.rs is pub mod (lib.rs:77, re-exported lib.rs:115) with a parallel &str permission canon and HashSet<String> surfaces (everyone_permissions, resolve_channel_permissions) next to the new ChatPermission; decide move or freeze. (3) JMAP-0x0q.55: apply_space_patch contract table (backend.rs:1330-1331) lacks the role-hierarchy rule for addMembers/updateMembers and the patch-key-naming last-admin rule from spec 061a30f; contract change for every backend implementor, privilege-escalation gap in MemoryBackend. Close this when all three are landed or explicitly deferred with a recorded semver plan.
